final_message.text:
I parsed `workspace/worker.log` by reading line-by-line and identifying log entries matching the standard format (`[<date> <time> <offset>] <service> | <LEVEL> | <message>`). For each entry:
1. Checked if its level (case-insensitively) was `ERROR`, `SEVERE`, or `FATAL`. Skipped all other levels (`INFO`, `WARN`, `DEBUG`).
2. Converted the local timestamp and its UTC offset (`+0700`, `-0500`, etc.) into UTC time formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.
3. Skipped any extra indented payload lines belonging to the entry.
4. Accumulated any following `-- last message repeated N times --` lines to calculate `repeat_count` ($1 + \sum N$).
5. Extracted the message text after the last ` | ` separator on the entry's first line.
6. Computed service-level sums of `repeat_count` into `counts_by_service`.

Created/changed files:
- `workspace/errors.json`
